experience.luffy: Every job taught him something. Some of the best lessons came from the least expected places!

jobs.did: Evaluating AI model responses against detailed rubric scales on freelance projects
jobs.learned: Judging an answer fairly against a rubric takes as much rigour as writing one

jobs.did: Designing and building machine learning solutions for real client projects: customer happiness prediction, a two-layer term deposit calling model, and an LLM-based candidate ranking pipeline
jobs.learned: Real client data is messy and small, so honest evaluation matters as much as the model

jobs.did: Analysed over a million member, transaction and loan records a month, built and maintained 15+ Power BI dashboards for leadership, wrote SQL on a Snowflake warehouse, and automated recurring reports, cutting manual work by 45%
jobs.learned: A dashboard is only useful if leadership trusts the numbers, so reconciliation and data governance come first

jobs.place: Delhi, India (remote while studying in Canada, 2022–2023)
jobs.did: Processed and validated 500K+ daily market data records, wrote SQL for fixed-income and equities reporting, and built Python validation programs that improved data quality assessments by 35%
jobs.learned: At market scale, small data errors become big ones, so automated validation beats manual checking
My first step into Android programming: building and delivering an app for a local client

jobs.did: Built and maintained Python scripts and applications
